W: Wet stone. Someone has scratched a tally into it. They stopped at forty.
G: Iron bars, cold and close together. Down the passage, a guard is snoring.
b: A bunk with a straw mattress. It has seen better centuries.
,: Old straw. Something small lives in it, and would like you to leave.
k: A stub of candle on an iron stand. The guards must have missed it.
It burns like the Archive's candles.
2: Iron bars, cold and close together. Down the passage, a guard is snoring.
p: Iron bars. Somebody on the other side is breathing very loudly.
1: A ladder up, to the floor above.
t: The guards' table. Half a sandwich, a dice cup, and a sign: ON WATCH 24/7. Under it, in different handwriting: (mostly).
c: A torch in a bracket, guttering.
3: The guards' stair, up to the town. Locked from the other side. Of course it is.
4: The cell door. Locked, and the key is upstairs with somebody who doesn't like you.

objects.name: Brannoc
lines: Who are you? What do you want?

answer: My name is Brannoc.
I woke up here two days ago. I have no idea what's going on.
Well. I kind of woke up out of this... cocoon-like fixture.
I walked into town, and everything was different. I barely recognised it.
Some guards came over. To help me, maybe? I wasn't sure what they wanted. They shouted.
I got scared and bumped into an apple cart.
They say I'm serving fifty to life.
Fifty years. To life.

questions.ask: We need to break out of here.
answer: Impossible. The guards watch this place 24/7.
And besides, these bars look impenetrable.

farewell: Go on. I'll keep the corner safe. Someone has to.

objects.name: Nails
lines: Don't look at me like that.
I only stole the king's spoon.
Then the king's other spoon. Then I got greedy.

answer: Soup.
You wouldn't understand. You've never had the king's soup.

objects.name: Old Mott
lines: Five hundred years I've been in here.
...No, wait. Five. Five years. It feels like five hundred.

answer: Said the statue in the square looked like a potato.
It does, though. Look at it. Potato.
Yes.
I return library books late. On purpose.

objects.name: Gary
lines: I'm not going to stop you. I don't get paid enough for this.

answer: Gary.
Gary. Of the cells.
There was a Gary of the gate. He got promoted. Now he's Gary of the other gate.

questions.ask: How much do they pay you?
answer: We don't get paid at all.
They call it 'the honour of the Crown.'
I can't eat the honour of the Crown. I've tried.
At the Kaldorium. Big fight tonight.
Somebody had to stay. Somebody is always Gary.

questions.ask: Aren't you going to stop me?
answer: No.
Still no.
It says that on the sign.
I'm the 24/7.

farewell: Close the door on your way out. There is no door. Close it anyway.

objects.name: Brannoc
lines: I'm not sulking. I'm guarding the corner. Again.

answer: ...Really?
You're sure? You're not just saying it?
Okay. Okay! I'll offer you my sword. Again. Properly this time.
then: Brannoc grabs his sword and hurries out after you, beaming.

questions.ask: Why did you come back here?
answer: It's the only place I know.
Also the guards wave at me now. It's very confusing.

farewell: I'll be here. In the corner. If you need a corner guarded.
